verdict.rationale: Cooley has a dedicated 'Patent counseling and prosecution' group page. It describes a global team of more than 100 patent lawyers and professionals serving as patent counsel to more than 3,500 companies, which meets the 'documented practice with group pages' requirement for patent prosecution. Missing for 10: explicit description of drafting and filing workflows and of portfolio-strategy or defensibility work, named individual practitioners, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: Cooley's global patent team includes 100+ lawyers and professionals across the US, UK and Europe, many holding PhDs and advanced engineering degrees.
We serve as patent counsel to 3,500+ companies worldwide
